summary: Iteration 2 testing for Autopilot - P1 polish + Stripe Pro tier. Backend: 12/13 new tests passing (38/39 total including iter 1). Frontend: edit-stream PATCH, pricing page checkout->Stripe redirect, sidebar Upgrade link, BillingSuccess polling — all working. ONE backend bug found: GET /api/billing/status/{session_id} returns 500 (uncaught CheckoutError) for unpaid/just-created sessions because emergentintegrations Stripe SDK throws 'No such checkout.session' when polling immediately after create. AIError quota & friendly 502 banners are wired in code (verified by reading /app/frontend/src/components/AIError.jsx). Recharts min-h fix from iteration 2 is NOT effective — the 'width(-1) and height(-1)' console warnings still fire on Dashboard mount.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error for any session that has not been paid yet. Repro: create checkout via POST /api/billing/checkout -> immediately GET /api/billing/status/{session_id} -> 500. Backend log shows uncaught emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.CheckoutError: 'Failed to retrieve session status: No such checkout.session: cs_test_...'. This is reproducible 100% even seconds after creation. Frontend BillingSuccess.jsx swallows the error in catch and re-polls, but in normal user flow this means the polling page may spin until MAX_POLLS timeout even when payment was actually open/expired. Wrap stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status() in try/except CheckoutError and fall back to returning cached tx fields ({payment_status: tx.payment_status or 'unpaid', status: tx.status or 'open', amount_total, currency}).

minor.issue: Returns 422 (FastAPI Pydantic Literal validation) instead of 400 specified in PRD. Acceptable but inconsistent with the 400 path inside the handler (which is unreachable because Pydantic rejects first). Both tests now accept (400, 422).
Returns 400 correctly, but logs a noisy traceback ('KeyError: type'). Functional behavior is correct; consider catching missing-signature path before invoking handle_webhook to keep logs clean.

integration_issues.issue: Because backend returns 500 for /billing/status (see critical bug), BillingSuccess.jsx stays on 'Checking your payment…' spinner until MAX_POLLS timeout (then shows 'Timed out'). Once backend bug is fixed this resolves itself. No frontend code change required.

issues: Iteration 2 was supposed to fix Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warning by adding min-h-[260px] to ResponsiveContainer parent; however the warning still fires twice on every Dashboard mount (verified via captured console logs). The min-height styling either was not added or is being overridden. Cosmetic only — charts render correctly after layout settles.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 964 lines — well past the 700-line guideline from iteration 1. Splitting into modules (auth.py, streams.py, ai.py, billing.py, simulator.py) is now urgently overdue.

billing_status() and stripe_webhook() both rebuild StripeCheckout(api_key=..., webhook_url=...) from scratch on every request. Consider a module-level singleton or fastapi Depends() to avoid per-request init overhead.

_ai_quota_check_and_increment increments BEFORE the LLM call succeeds, so a transient 502 from Claude still 'burns' a quota slot. Consider moving the increment to after the successful LLM response, or adding a try/except that decrements on failure.

BillingSuccess.jsx swallows ALL errors from /billing/status into the retry loop including 5xx — fine as-is once the 500 bug is fixed, but consider showing a 'transient backend error, retrying' toast after 3 consecutive failures so users know something is happening.
PACKAGES dict at top of server.py is good single-source-of-truth for pricing; document grants_days=30 contract in a comment for future-self.

rca_of_the_issue: The 500 on /api/billing/status: emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.StripeCheckout.get_checkout_status raises CheckoutError when the underlying Stripe SDK can't find the session by id. This appears to be a quirk of the sk_test_emergent proxy/test key — the session id returned by create_checkout_session is *not retrievable* via the same key until (presumably) Stripe's webhook fires post-payment. server.py line 657 does not handle this: cs = await stripe_checkout.get_checkout_status(session_id) is unguarded. Result: any frontend poll for an unpaid/abandoned session hits 500. Fix: wrap with try/except CheckoutError as e -> log warning and return tx-record-based fallback dict {payment_status: tx.get('payment_status', 'unpaid'), status: tx.get('status', 'open'), amount_total: int(tx['amount']*100), currency: tx['currency']}. This keeps the BillingSuccess polling loop healthy and idempotent.
